Sinners has just made Oscar history with a record-breaking 16 Academy Award nominations, the most any film has ever received in Oscar history, surpassing the previous record of 14 nominations held by All About Eve, Titanic, and La La Land. 

This historic achievement spans every major category from Best Picture, Director, Actor (Michael B. Jordan), Supporting Actor (Delroy Lindo), Supporting Actress (Wunmi Mosaku), Original Screenplay, and many technical fields making Sinners the most-nominated film in Academy Awards history. 

Ryan Coogler’s supernatural thriller has clearly struck a chord with the Academy and audiences alike, blending genre storytelling with powerful themes and performances, and now stands as one of the most talked-about films of the 2026 awards season.
